source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The Theme constructor delegates conversion of light/dark details and experiment data to LightweightThemeManager.themeDataFrom. For a static theme it saves only {lwtData}; load then applies that parsed object to the window override or global fallback and sends the styling notification. The old load-time lwtStyles/lwtDarkStyles assembly is removed. This separates construction from application in the comm wrapper. The shared engine converter and early startup consumer are bounded dependencies, so this source proves the wrapper arguments, cache shape and ordering, not every converted color or restart outcome.
title: Parse theme data before applying and persisting the startup cache
